create_line_zone: create a LineZone to count objects crossing a predefined line between two Points
run_line_zone_trigger: run LineZone.trigger to detect which detections crossed the line in the current frame
build_line_zone_annotator: build a LineZoneAnnotator to draw the line and in/out counts on a video frame
build_line_zone_annotator_multiclass: build a LineZoneAnnotatorMulticlass to draw a table of per-class crossing counts for multiple line zones
test_line_zone_crossing: test LineZone crossing detection with tracker_id-based object tracking across frames
